name: extract_invoice_data
description: Extracts structured data from an invoice document.

is_invoice.description: True if the document is an actual invoice, false if it is a quote, receipt, or other document type.

total_due.description: The final total amount due. Must be null if the document is not an invoice.

po_number.description: The Purchase Order number. This field is nullable. If a PO is not explicitly present, return null. Do not fabricate a value.

currency_other_detail.description: If currency is 'other', provide the exact currency string found in the document here. Otherwise null.

exam_takeaway: Using tool_use with JSON schema GUARANTEES syntax-compliant JSON. To prevent semantic hallucination (fabricating data), use optional/nullable fields ('type': ['string', 'null']). For extensibility, use the 'other' enum value paired with a free-text detail field.
